canonical_claim.template: In 2025, {value} of decisioned VA applications in the US were denied (115,026 denials out of 712,121 applications reaching a credit decision).

required_qualifiers.population: decisioned VA applications (actions 1,2,3; reverse mortgages excluded)

does_not_establish: that VA loans are easier or harder to get than FHA, USDA or conventional loans (applicant populations differ by eligibility and composition; cross-program rates are not comparable as a judgement of programs or lenders)
rule: Free text is the OUTPUT of evidence, not its input. Certify before you write.

proposed_use.proposed_sentence: This lender will likely reject YOUR application
